annotations.title: Housing carry: rent vs mortgage interest per city

description: Carry nieruchomości finwire (finwire_housing_carry): per Polish city, the net rental yield of a typical 2-room flat (after one vacant month, flat-rate rental tax, admin fee in vacant months and property tax) minus the variable mortgage interest rate, in percentage points, monthly with history, plus net rent minus first-year interest in PLN per month for a loan covering the whole price. Negative carry = interest exceeds net rent; buying to let on credit then relies on price growth. For rents and plain yields use get_rents. Informational data, not investment advice.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") to get one city with its monthly history; omit for all cities.
